description: MCP sign-in appears only after an authentication challenge. The screen is the default 393x727 phone. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means the name is exactly X. To "open the panel": navigate to /new, press Control+k, fill ".command-palette-input" with "MCP Servers", and click the first ".command-palette-item"; "the panel", the dialog named "MCP Servers" (the element [role="dialog"]:has(.modal-xwide)), should be visible. The server lists one MCP server, "oauth", with no authentication state yet; call "challenge" makes it report that it needs a login at /mcp/login/oauth. Perform the steps in order. 1. Open the panel. 2. The panel must have no link named "Sign in" (count 0). 3. Call "challenge", then click the panel's button named "Refresh". 4. The panel's link named "Sign in" should have the attribute href="/mcp/login/oauth".
